title: Halloween in Houston

lines.say: Hi friends! I'm Danny the Dino, and Halloween is almost here! Here's what to do around Houston this weekend.
Friday from five to eight, trick-or-treat store to store at CityCentre. It's free!
Or head downtown to Scream on the Green at Discovery Green, Friday from six to nine. Also free!
Saturday is the very last day of Zoo Boo at the Houston Zoo.
And Saturday night, grab a flashlight and trick-or-treat your own neighborhood!
On Sunday, celebrate Día de los Muertos at the Children's Museum.
Happy haunting, little monsters! Follow Spring Branch Littles for more fun plans!

caption:
Danny the Dino has your Halloween weekend in Houston covered! 🎃🦕

Fri: CityCentre trick-or-treat (5–8 pm, free) or Scream on the Green at Discovery Green (6–9 pm, free)
Sat: Last day of Zoo Boo, then trick-or-treat your street at dusk
Sun: Día de los Muertos at the Children's Museum

What's your little monster dressing up as? 👻

Times can change, so check before you go. Follow @springbranchlittles for kid-friendly plans every week.
